name: tile_loop_nest
description: Partition loop nests into fixed-size tiles to improve cache locality and data reuse. Applies tiling to structured operations (linalg) by decomposing iteration spaces into blocks that fit within target cache levels.

parameters.name: tile_sizes
parameters.description: List of tile sizes for each tiled dimension. A zero value skips tiling for that dimension. Length should match the number of loops in the operation's iteration space.

parameters.name: operation_tag
parameters.description: Optional tag to identify the target operation. If empty, the first linalg operation is selected.
